name: Mirror's Edge
notes: Promoted Broken → Playable after stubbing GamerServicesDispatcher.WindowHandle to a no-op auto-property. Android needed three further fixes: forcing the FNA3D OpenGL driver (the unfinished Vulkan driver mistranslates SkinnedEffect's indexed Bones array, leaving every character in bind pose), transcoding the .wma soundtrack at install time through ffmpeg-kit (FFMpegCore spawns an ffmpeg process an APK does not have, so the game was silently mute), and playing songs via Android MediaPlayer instead of FAudio's single-buffered song player.
